name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demo a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny. Tato verze pridava DirectWrite text fast path pro Direct2D backend, novou diagnostiku textoveho passu a aktualizovane link instrukce s Dwrite.lib.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources. This version adds a DirectWrite text fast path for the Direct2D backend, new text-pass diagnostics, and updated link instructions with Dwrite.lib.
